card.name: Should be considered in diagnosis
card.fires_on: The verb "included" or "considered" after "should be" or "must be", where a less obvious condition is to be kept in mind in the differential diagnosis. Also "them" after "seen" in talk of rarely seen diseases.

modes.label: Include in differential
modes.description: "included" or "in" after "should be" when a condition is added to the differential diagnosis.
modes.example: Intestinal angioedema should be<< included>> in the differential diagnosis of patients on ACE

modes.label: Should be considered
modes.description: "considered" after "should be" or "must be" when naming a possible cause to keep in mind.
modes.example: This diagnosis should be<< considered>> for diarrhea that does not improve [see

modes.description: Object word after "seen" when discussing diseases clinicians seldom encounter.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about rarity, such as "rare" and "cases", as in a rarely seen cause being flagged.
card.plain: It fires when the text says an uncommon cause should be kept in mind when working out a diagnosis.
